$comment: SHIPPED DEFAULT agent organization for a fresh installation.
The capability layer resolves the initiating actor from the declared
org before it will answer any bridge action; with no org it refuses
with BRIDGE_ACTOR_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE. The builder's own org names
the builder's seats, accounts and account lanes, which are personal
data and are meaningless on a customer's machine. So the build stages
It declares the single seat every installation starts with: one
enabled controller, no provider bound yet, no phase assigned, and no
relationships, because a fresh install has no org to describe. Binding
a provider is a setup step (the customer signs in), not a shipped
assumption, so provider is "none" until then.
assertSingleController() requires exactly one enabled controller, so
this file must always carry exactly one.
